steps.title: Cease all communication
steps.detail: Immediately stop all interactions with the suspected scammer. Block phone numbers, messaging accounts, and email addresses.

steps.title: Secure online accounts
steps.detail: Change passwords on your primary email, banking portals, and social media accounts. Enable multi-factor authentication everywhere.

steps.title: Preserve incident records
steps.detail: Take clear screenshots of conversations, transaction receipts, website addresses, and caller numbers before deleting anything.

steps.title: Lodge an official report
steps.detail: File a report with your local police department or national cybercrime agency for official investigation and documentation.

steps.title: Important note
steps.detail: This is general guidance, not legal advice.

steps.title: Emergency bank contact & transaction recall
steps.detail: Immediately contact your bank's fraud hotline. Request an urgent freeze on your account and ask whether the outbound transfer can be halted or recalled.

steps.title: Document transaction identifiers
steps.detail: Note the recipient bank name, account number, account holder name, reference number, exact amount, and transfer timestamp.

steps.title: File a formal police report
steps.detail: Provide bank statements and transaction receipts to the police. Obtain a copy of the official police report for your bank's fraud department.

steps.title: Monitor statements for suspicious activity
steps.detail: Review your account statements daily for unauthorized debits or recurring mandates. Request new account numbers if security was compromised.

steps.title: Important note
steps.detail: This is general guidance, not legal advice.

steps.title: Call bank fraud desk & National Scam Response Centre
steps.detail: Immediately contact your financial institution's 24/7 fraud hotline to freeze compromised accounts and initiate interbank fund recall.

steps.title: Gather transfer and recipient information
steps.detail: Record the receiving bank, account number, beneficiary name, transfer reference code, and exact time of transaction.

steps.title: Lodge Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) report
steps.detail: Visit the nearest police station with transaction printouts. Submit the police report number to your bank within 24 hours.

steps.title: Important note
steps.detail: This is general guidance, not legal advice.

steps.title: Contact bank branch & freeze outbound account
steps.detail: Immediately visit or call your bank's emergency customer service to report fraudulent transfer and block outgoing payments.

steps.title: Collect transaction vouchers & connectIPS logs
steps.detail: Save digital payment receipts, transaction IDs, and recipient account details from connectIPS, mobile banking, or branch slips.

steps.title: Report to Nepal Police Cyber Bureau
steps.detail: Submit an official complaint with screenshots and transaction vouchers to the Nepal Police Cyber Bureau or local district police office.

steps.title: Important note
steps.detail: This is general guidance, not legal advice.

steps.title: Lock or unlink digital wallet
steps.detail: Access your e-wallet security settings to log out of all devices, change your PIN, and unlink saved bank accounts or debit cards.

steps.title: Contact e-wallet support immediately
steps.detail: Submit a fraud report to the wallet provider with the transaction reference ID, recipient phone number or wallet ID, and timestamp.

steps.title: File a cybercrime report
steps.detail: Lodge an official report with law enforcement, providing e-wallet statement exports and chat records.

steps.title: Important note
steps.detail: This is general guidance, not legal advice.

steps.title: Suspend e-wallet and reset security credentials
steps.detail: Immediately suspend your e-wallet account via provider customer support or in-app security toggle. Reset your 6-digit transaction PIN.

steps.title: Lodge dispute with e-wallet operator
steps.detail: Submit an unauthorized transaction claim along with merchant details, DuitNow transfer reference, and scam conversation logs.

steps.title: File police report at nearest station
steps.detail: File a PDRM report detailing the e-wallet transaction IDs and forward the report to the e-wallet security team.

steps.title: Important note
steps.detail: This is general guidance, not legal advice.

steps.title: Block digital wallet account & change MPIN
steps.detail: Immediately change your wallet transaction MPIN and contact provider customer support to freeze your wallet profile.

steps.title: Report dispute to wallet support
steps.detail: Provide the transaction code, recipient mobile number, transfer purpose, and time to provider fraud support.

steps.title: Report to Cyber Bureau
steps.detail: File an application with the Nepal Police Cyber Bureau including printouts of your wallet transaction statement.

steps.title: Important note
steps.detail: This is general guidance, not legal advice.

steps.title: Immediately block the payment card
steps.detail: Use your mobile banking app or call your card issuer's emergency number to block your debit or credit card permanently.

steps.title: Initiate unauthorized transaction dispute
steps.detail: Request a chargeback for unauthorized or fraudulent charges within your card issuer's dispute window.

steps.title: Request card re-issuance
steps.detail: Ask your bank to issue a replacement card with a new primary account number and security code (CVV).

steps.title: Important note
steps.detail: This is general guidance, not legal advice.

steps.title: Secure wallet private keys and seed phrases
steps.detail: Never share your seed phrase or private keys. If you entered your seed phrase on a phishing site, transfer any remaining assets to a fresh hardware wallet immediately.

steps.title: Document transaction hash & wallet addresses
steps.detail: Record the destination wallet address, transaction hash (TxID), blockchain network, exact token amount, and timestamp from the block explorer.

steps.title: Notify custodial exchanges
steps.detail: If the destination address belongs to a centralized exchange, report the transaction hash to their compliance department for address flagging.

steps.title: Beware of recovery scammers
steps.detail: Do not pay anyone claiming they can hack or recover your lost cryptocurrency. Legitimate recovery services do not solicit via social media.

steps.title: Important note
steps.detail: This is general guidance, not legal advice.

steps.title: Change compromised credentials
steps.detail: If you entered passwords on a fraudulent page, change them immediately across all services where that password was reused.

steps.title: Revoke active login sessions
steps.detail: Use account security settings to terminate all active sessions and app authorizations.

steps.title: Scan device for malicious software
steps.detail: If you downloaded any attachment or file from the phishing link, run a full antivirus and anti-malware scan on your device.

steps.title: Important note
steps.detail: This is general guidance, not legal advice.

steps.title: Verify through official public channels
steps.detail: Do not use contact numbers or links provided by the caller. Search independently for the organization's official public switchboard.

steps.title: Alert friends and family
steps.detail: If the scammer impersonated you or compromised your social media, warn your contacts not to respond to urgent money requests.

steps.title: Report impersonation account
steps.detail: Use in-app reporting tools on WhatsApp, Telegram, or Facebook to flag the scammer profile for impersonation.

steps.title: Important note
steps.detail: This is general guidance, not legal advice.
